verdict.rationale: Sentry documents background automation in two forms. Seer Autofix automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes, triages them and can generate fix PRs; it can also launch Cursor Cloud Agents or be assigned Linear issues. Separately, rule-based Alerts take actions (notifications, tickets, webhooks, integrations) when issues match pre-defined rules. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring when and how much Seer acts unattended (triggers, autonomy levels, approval gates), automations beyond the issue/alert domain, and independent or hands-on corroboration that autonomous runs work reliably.
